title: Tie-in / terminal point register (TP-: Owner/Contractor, IF-: interfaces between consortium members); owner_side = employer side of the contract. Pressures in barg (vacuum as negative barg), temperatures in degC; the tie_in_register engine checks every point against all HMB cases and against its upstream point

owner_side.description: what the Owner provides up to the tie-in

contractor_side.description: what the Contractor provides from the tie-in

available_by.description: date the providing side makes the point available

status.description: agreed = confirmed by both sides (agreed_by), frozen = no change without a TQ

agreed_ref.description: TQ in which the point was agreed

boundary.description: exact scope break: which side owns the flange/weld, gasket, bolts, counter-flange, cable lugs, support

connection.description: end preparation / rating / facing, or terminal type / protocol

isolation.description: isolation and its ownership (valves, spectacle blind, disconnector, earthing)

protection.description: overpressure / overload / limiting devices protecting the downstream side, with set points

flow_max.description: in flow_unit; capacity the providing side guarantees at this point

density.description: to convert volume flow units to kg/s (at standard conditions for Sm3/h and Nm3/h)

flow_limited.description: flow/power is actively limited to flow_max at this point (see protection)

short_circuit.description: maximum prospective short-circuit current at the point

short_circuit_rating.description: short-circuit withstand rating of the equipment at the point

power_factor.description: power factor at which flow_max (MVA) is checked against the HMB power (hmb_metric)

hmb_stream.description: process_stream number that crosses this point in every HMB case

hmb_check.description: which HMB quantities apply at this point (default full); a partial check needs a remark

hmb_metric.description: HMB power crossing an electrical point

upstream.description: point that feeds this one through passive equipment (no pump/transformer in between)

chain_dp.description: maximum pressure loss from the upstream point to this point at flow_max

quality_refs.description: quality / specification limits of the medium at this point

needed_by.description: date the receiving side needs the point (from the key dates / commissioning sequence)

related_scope.description: further scope items this point serves
